purpose: GoMate mountain and coffee website icon concepts; pending user selection

concepts.label: 1 · Flat · 精修版
concepts.prompt: Generate ONE premium FLAT DESIGN website icon as a square 1:1 high-resolution PNG. This is a finished icon image, not a mockup or a board. GoMate brand palette: warm amber #D97706, cream #FFFBEB, burnt terracotta #B94E12, and warm umber coffee. Full-bleed gentle ivory-to-pale-apricot gradient background, no frame. EXACT SUBJECT: ONE mountain with ONE main peak, ONE coffee cup with a big recognizable loop handle and a broad oval coffee opening. A crisp geometric amber mountain sits behind a rounded terracotta coffee cup, the cup overlaps its lower third. Mountain has one simple cream triangular snow cap. Cup has a cream rim and a flat dark umber coffee oval. All subject surfaces are perfectly UNIFORM SOLID FLAT COLOR; absolutely no subject gradients, no shadows, no texture, no glossy highlights, no 3D lighting, no blended tonal shading. Only the soft BACKGROUND can be a gradient. Sophisticated graphic design, crisp bold flat filled shapes, lively but elegant. Use only five large simple filled shapes plus the handle cutout. Subject centered, total subject bounds from 18% to 82% of canvas in each dimension; generous clear margins. Avoid illustrative oversized detail: the mountain peak and the handle must both remain clear at 32 pixels. No steam, sun, beans, leaves, trees, people, saucer, extra objects, writing, characters, letters, numbers, labels, watermarks or border. No SVG/code: return the actual raster image.

concepts.label: 2 · Minimal · 精修版
concepts.prompt: Create ONE exceptionally elegant MINIMAL MONOLINE brand icon as an actual square 1:1 high-quality PNG. Warm outdoors-and-coffee brand GoMate. Full-bleed extremely soft pale ivory to warm sand/apricot gradient background. Central warm deep amber #B65A08 symbol formed from just a few very bold rounded lines: a SINGLE mountain peak above a single small unmistakable COFFEE CUP, united into one compact pleasing emblem. The mountain is a simple open triangular contour, broad rounded angular up-and-down stroke, with ONE apex and NO snowcap, no detailed ridges; its lower slope visually nestles into the cup's upper edge. The coffee cup below is an elegant rounded U-shaped bowl, a simple broad oval top with dark umber coffee indication, and one large open round handle on the side. The cup must look like a cup and the mountain must look like a mountain even at 32px. Graphic monochrome amber contours, one flat dark umber coffee detail, cream negative space; NO fully colored filled mountain, NO photorealism, NO bevels, NO 3D, NO cast shadows, NO material textures, NO glossy rendering, NO internal color gradients, NO extra lines. Use broad approximately 7%-of-canvas stroke width so no fine detail disappears. Total combined symbol about 62% canvas width and 64% height, optically centered with generous equal margins of 18%. Restrained, fresh, smart contemporary pictogram, graceful geometry with mildly playful roundedness. No steam swirls, sun, landscape, floating decorations, beans, saucer, border, text, letters, numbers or watermark. Produce only the finished PNG image, not a design presentation.

concepts.label: 3 · 3D clay
concepts.prompt: Create ONE finished premium website/app icon for GoMate, a warm, friendly platform for exploring places and meeting companions. Deliver an actual raster PNG image, square 1:1, high resolution ideally 1024x1024. Only the icon itself fills the square canvas: no presentation board, no variations grid, no device mockup, no text, no letters, no numbers, no watermarks. There must be exactly ONE recognizable mountain with ONE main peak and ONE unmistakable coffee cup with a clearly visible open handle and coffee surface. Compose these two elements into a cohesive balanced centered symbol: the mountain rises behind and above the cup, the cup nests in the lower foreground. The overlapping objects should have elegant chunky silhouettes and readable separation. Nothing else: no sun, leaves, beans, trees, figures, landscape panorama or decorative floating objects. The overall combined subject occupies about 66-70% of the square, preserving at least 15% clear safe margin on every edge. Full-bleed softly graduated opaque background from warm ivory #FFF8EC and pale sand into pale apricot #F7D8AF, restrained and luminous. Match the project's warm amber #D97706, cream #FFFBEB, sand neutrals and a very restrained warm coral accent; deep warm umber can provide contrast. No cold gray, green, blue, purple, black background or rainbow colors. Elegant yet lively, welcoming and memorable, polished optical balance. Small-size legibility is paramount: at 32x32 both the mountain peak and coffee-cup handle remain immediately discernible. Use only a few broad masses, generous negative space, no tiny ornament, no thin hairlines. Produce the specified style strongly and consistently. STYLE: premium 3D CLAY sculpture, tactile matte ceramic/plasticine material, soft pillowy bevels, gentle realistic ambient occlusion. One rounded amber mountain with a simple creamy snowcap; one plump ivory coffee mug nestled in front with a generous thick round handle and broad visible dark-coffee oval. Playful small sculptural still life, mostly frontal, slight three-quarter mug angle, balanced centered composition. Warm studio lighting from upper left, restrained soft contact shadow. No grit, no fine realistic texture, no little objects, no sharp facets, no pedestal. Beautifully crafted and friendly.
